sec.serverDesc: The view filters nothing itself: it debounces the search (300 ms), writes everything to the URL and hands the page a query to fetch. The last rows stay on screen while the next answer loads (refresh bar, no skeletons).
sec.query: The query the page fetches with
sec.queryDesc: Exactly what view.query holds now; reload the page and it comes back from the URL.
